messages:
sam: Noticed another cluster of partial streaming responses this morning (eu-west). Need owners + clear short-term steps.
maya: I'll own client retry guidance + quick SDK patch for exponential backoff.
kevin: I'll add server-side logging for reconnect reason codes. Need fields we want.
priya: I'll spin up canary with increased LB handshake and watch node-level error rates for eu-west.
lia: I'll validate SDK reconnect flow and make a regression test harness.
oncall-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-172030 - streaming partial spike (eu-west). Priority: P2.
sam: Action checklist: what are the concrete AIs and deadlines? Keep them short.
maya: AI-1 (maya) - SDK mitigation PR (backoff 100ms -> max 2s, attempts 4) + example update. Due: 1720330000 (tomorrow).
kevin: AI-2 (kevin) - emit telemetry: "reconnect_reason","handshake_ms","final_status"; land in prod staging. Due: 1720320000 (18h).
priya: AI-3 (priya) - LB handshake bump to 10s on canary + grafana panel for handshake_ms by region. Due: 1720310000 (12h).
lia: AI-4 (lia) - SDK reconnect harness with flaky-net and idempotency token validation. Due: 1720380000 (5 days).
sam: Oncall playbook update: if partial_rate > 2.5% for 15m in eu-west -> page infra and pin to previous model variant. Lia to draft one-pager.
kevin: Note: need to avoid double-send when reconnect resumes - include a quick checksum/idempotency in SDK patch.
maya: Will include temporary client-level dedupe heuristics; full idempotency in next sprint.
priya: Found increased TCP retries on a subset of nodes in eu-west; posting node ids in a follow-up.
sam: Good catch. Priya, include logs snippet and correlate with handshake_ms.
kevin: If rollback needed use infra rollback link: https://internal.redwood/infra/rollback
oncall-bot: Follow-up meeting created: 1720333000 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).
sam: I'll add these AIs to the tracker and tag owners. Keep updates here and ping if anything blocks 12h actions. :thumbsup:
